title: Amanuensis: hotkey to text at the cursor
summary: Closed the loop on the local macOS dictation daemon — hold right-option, speak, release, and the words appear at the cursor. Ten real dictations measured p50 223 ms / p95 270 ms end to end against a 400 ms budget, with injection verified by reading the text back out of TextEdit, Terminal, VS Code, and Chrome rather than by eye.
